# Package Agent Guide

This repository packages the `apply-harness-engineering` skill. Keep the skill itself model-agnostic, keep target-repository templates explicit about applicability, and do not turn the bundled helper into a target-project lifecycle service.

## Start here

- Skill contract: [`SKILL.md`](SKILL.md)
- Public package overview: [`README.md`](README.md)
- Package architecture: [`ARCHITECTURE.md`](ARCHITECTURE.md)
- Target-project templates: [`assets/templates/project/`](assets/templates/project/)
- Current AI-runtime guidance: [`assets/templates/project/docs/agent-harness/model-and-agent-runtime.md`](assets/templates/project/docs/agent-harness/model-and-agent-runtime.md)
- Evaluation contract: [`assets/templates/project/docs/agent-harness/evals.md`](assets/templates/project/docs/agent-harness/evals.md)
- Source boundaries: [`references/source-boundaries.md`](references/source-boundaries.md)

## Working contract

- Preserve the installation boundary: installing this package must not inspect, modify, schedule, or certify a target repository.
- Keep the bundled harness helper read-only; target projects own their native gate and runtime commands.
- Keep GPT-specific features in the optional AI-runtime contract. Do not make MCP, Agents SDK, or production attestation universal requirements.
- Certification is not used by default. Keep the native project gate as the normal completion proof; use the optional strict certification overlay only when explicitly requested.
- Use `apply_patch` for source and documentation changes. Do not create or change branches, tags, commits, or releases unless explicitly authorized.
- Keep generated bytecode and local artifacts out of the tracked source tree.

## Verification

```text
PYTHONDONTWRITEBYTECODE=1 python3 -m unittest discover -s scripts/tests
python3 -B scripts/harness.py check --root .
python3 -B scripts/harness.py audit --root . --format json
```

For release packaging, use `scripts/build_release_zip.py` with an output path outside this repository and an already clean Git worktree.
